answer_1.quote: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has been a critical part of recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) ... At the core of RLHF methods, Reward Models (RMs) are used to guide the LLM (i.e., policy) training by scoring generated responses.

answer_2.quote: Following prior work and due to its popularity (e.g., more than 150 entries), we evaluate our trained models using RewardBench, which contains ∼3k assorted tasks from 23 different datasets. ... We report the accuracy for each category and an overall score by averaging the accuracies.

answer_4.quote: Given the heavy reliance of our work on Reward-Bench, we conduct an independent verification of the preferences. Specifically, we sample 50 tasks ... Then, we gather 3 annotations from different annotators and use a majority vote to determine the final preference. All annotators were senior Computer Science PhD students specializing in NLP with extensive experience ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose the preferred response for each task via binary preference.
